text:
Maya Chen: @here prepping Aurelia review next Wed. Need a focused cost readout + 30/90-day spend forecasts + enablement asks. Token econ spiked after their integration — want root cause and mitigation recs.

Ravi Patel: On it. I'll pull 90-day spend with per-endpoint token breakdown. Quick Q — did they flip to embeddings-heavy usage last week?

Samir Gomez: They did. Embedding endpoint ramped on 2025-03-18, saw ~2x embed calls/day for two services. I can map sample sessions and top callers.

Lena Ortiz: Tracking enablement requests — Aurelia asked for a short playbook: prompt compaction tips, cache examples, and a 1-pager for PMs about cost vs UX tradeoffs. I can draft.

Maya Chen: Perfect. Requirements from me:
- delta vs baseline (last 30d vs prior 30d)
- projected burn for next 30/90 days under three scenarios (steady, +50% growth, peak burst)
- alert thresholds wired to CS with email escalation (70/85/95%)
- quick recs: quantized model vs standard, prefix caching, and quota guardrails

Ravi Patel: I'll produce the three scenarios + token-per-response metric (CPER = cost per effective response) and a suggested cost table comparing model variants. ETA: EOD tomorrow.

Samir Gomez: Will attach session traces and top-10 prompts that cause long sequences. Early note: a single background job is emitting long context (~25k tokens) on error loop — looks like a retry bug. Recommend prefix/KV caching and a max-context cutoff.

Maya Chen: Good catch — can you add a short snippet for engineers showing how to enable prefix caching? Something we can paste into the enablement doc.

Samir Gomez: Yup. Snippet:```
# enable prefix caching (pseudocode)
cache = PrefixCache(max_size=10000)
response = model.generate(request, cache=cache)
```
Also recommending request-level max_tokens: 4096 for that flow.

Ravi Patel: For alerts, suggested config we can hand to infra:```
alerts:
  - threshold: 0.70
    notify: cs-team@redwood.com
  - threshold: 0.85
    notify: cs-ops, finance
  - threshold: 0.95
    escalate: account-owner@aurelia.com
    action: suspend-bursting
```
I'll also include a sample webhook payload for the CS email.

Lena Ortiz: I'll draft the enablement playbook and two sessions:
- Engineering deep dive (prompting, caching, model selection)
- Product/PM cost primer (how to think about token trade-offs)
Proposed dates: Tue next week for eng, Thu for product. Will confirm availabilities.

Maya Chen: Action list (for thread):
- Ravi: scenarios + CPER + model comparison (due TOM EOD)
- Samir: session traces + cache snippet + long-seq root cause (due TOM EOD)
- Lena: enablement doc + schedule sessions (due Fri COB)
- Maya: assemble slides + coordinate with Aurelia (I'll confirm after Ravi's numbers)

billing-bot: Aurelia account snapshot: last 7d spend = $18,420, 30d = $68,700, avg daily = $2,290. Current credit utilization = 62%. (auto-report)

Maya Chen: Thanks. If anyone hits blockers wire up via DM. I'll ping again when Ravi posts numbers. :thumbsup:
